messages:
Ethan Rivers: morning team, first-week q — filling cloud access for a dev sandbox. Form errors on Billing Account lookup. Also need AWS assume-role + GCP project in `europe-west1` region. Do we need extra approval for eu regions? :wave:
Maya Singh: welcome Ethan! For billing make sure the ID uses dashes like `012345-678901-234567`. EU region is allowed for dev but some EU zones require data residency signoff. If you only need `europe-west1` it's fine; for `europe-west3` or multi-region EU ask cloud-compliance.
Ethan Rivers: thanks—billing id I entered was missing dashes. Can you attach and create project `redwood-dev-ethan`? Also need roles: `roles/browser`, `roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1`, and KMS decrypt on `projects/redwood-common/locations/europe/keyRings/dev-kr/cryptoKeys/dev-key`.
Maya Singh: will do. Creating ticket INFRA-12021. Adding you to `redwood-devs` group and `europe-kms-users`. Note AWS dev-role allows `eu-west-1` by default; to assume run `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/Redwood-Dev-Role --role-session-name ethan-onboard`.
ops-bot: Ticket INFRA-12021 created by maya for redwood-dev-ethan. ETA: ~25m.
Cloud Infra: billing attached and project created. KMS access granted; allow a few minutes for IAM propagation. Let us know if you hit any perm denies.
Ethan Rivers: accepted the AWS invite, tested gcloud decrypt and it worked. All green, thanks! :tada: 
Maya Singh: awesome — welcome aboard! If anything else blocks, ping #eng-infra and well escalate.
